notes.title: Online Multi-Player Version 1.3
notes.notes:
[h1]Summary[/h1]
The online multi-player update is here! You can now play VR Disc Golf online with up to three other players. Test your disc golf skills against real opponents. Hold the grip buttons to activate Voice Chat while you play on the two 18 hole courses.

[h1]What’s New[/h1]
[list][*]Four player online multi-player for each course![/*]
[*]Voice Chat by holding down the grip button on your controller while online[/*]
[*]A new multi-player lobby[/*]
[*]Play against anyone online[/*]
[*]Play with your friends online[/*]
[*]Join friends’ games through Steam Friends[/*]
[*]Send Invites through Steam Friends or the Lobby Invite Button[/*]
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes and Improvements[/h1]
[list][*]New sound for player score[/*]
[*]New sound for player death[/*]
[*]Close the Leaks warp gate power turned up[/*]
[*]Press the menu button on your controller to show the Scorecard, Actions, and Options[/*]
[*]Fixed lava glitches[/*]
[*]Text clipping fixed on ingame menu[/*][/list]

[h1]What’s Next[/h1]
Multi-Player is here! Online play has been a major request and we want to know what you think! We are excited to play online with you. Take part in the Discussion Hub to let us know where you think we should take VR Disc Golf next!

[b]Thank you for all of your support!  Have fun online![/b]

notes.title: Version 1.2
notes.notes:
[h1]Summary[/h1]
This update includes a second course!  Test your skills on “The Connection”, a new course which includes 18 holes with all new terrain, traps, water and concepts.  Explore the Tiki Volcano, the Pyramids, the Castle Ramparts, and more! 

[h1]What’s New[/h1]
[list][*]Play our new course - The Connection[/*][/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes and Improvements[/h1]
[list][*]Volume fixes for when the game starts[/*]
[*]Performance improvements with new course[/*]
[*]Fixed a scoring issue with party mode[/*]
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing the player to fly into the air[/*]
[*]Mulligan will teleport you to the correct position[/*]
[*]Fixed text clipping fixed on ingame menu[/*][/list]
[h1]Next Update[/h1]
We are still at work with online multiplayer.  Version 1.3 will include up to 4 player online play on a new planetary terrain course.  Stay tuned for more updates and visit the discussion boards with any questions.  

[b]Thank you for all of your support!  Especially the players on Twitch![/b]

notes.title: Version 1.1 Live!
notes.notes:
[h1]Summary[/h1]
What an amazing launch! Thanks to our community of amazing supporters, we have been hard at work preparing our first update to VR Disc Golf! With your awesome community feedback, we have made many improvements! The big ones are how the disc is held in your hand, overall disc-feel, and new particle effects/course tweaks.  Give it a try and let us know how accurate you are!

Other than that, we had oodles of bug fixes and map improvements. Check out the list below, and happy golfing!

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list][*]Menu interactions: Now with LASERS! (and hover-over effects)[/*][*]Complete controller model, and disc holding re-work (Thanks community!)[/*][*]New atmospheric particle effects added to current maps [/*][*]Party mode changes players after 9 holes.[/*][/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes/Improvements[/h1]
[list][*]First Mulligan per hole is now free.[/*][*]Less dropping to compositor[/*][*]Hole 15 “Windy Lava” now has wind on both sides of lava [/*][*]Disc switches hand based on which controller pulled trigger last[/*][*]Hole 18 “Daimyo’s Desire” now has laser beam covering approach fairway[/*][*]Music volume starts at 30% now[/*][*]Hole 14 “Booster gates” now has particle effects on down arrows and working gates[/*][*]Disc thrown out of bounds will now explode[/*][*]Hole 6 “Data Conduits” lava improved and tweaked slightly[/*][*]Wind Obelisks replaced with turbines to improve recognition of effect[/*][*]Clouds added to several maps[/*][*]Re-start hole button now sets score to 0 for the current hole[/*][*]Particles applied to booster gates[/*][*]In-Game Menu buttons won’t trigger after you close the menu now[/*][*]Players should now correctly earn achivements[/*][*]Disc can no longer be destroyed two times in a row[/*][*]Sometimes controllers were being assigned incorrect device index[/*][*]Disc no long flashes from ground up hand to holding position[/*][*]Performance Improvements on multiple holes[/*][*]Reduced sizes of discs[/*][*]Menu button brings you back to main menu at end of game[/*][*]Party mode now correctly displays scores [/*][*]Switch player scene now prevents throw[/*][*]Toggle front/back 9 button now works correctly[/*][*]Tons of little scorecard fixes[/*][*]Changes to the way strokes are accrued. Should make sense now[/*][/list]
[h1]Next Update[/h1]
We are going to keep up the bug hunt, and are working furiously towards a new 18 hole course. We will also continue updating how the disc is held in your hand.  After that it’s multiplayer and more realistic content. Stay tuned for updates, and visit the discussion boards with any questions.

[b]Thanks again to everyone who made such an amazing launch possible! Here’s to Version 1.2![/b]

notes.title: VR Disc Golf 1.0 Released on Steam!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We are very excited to announce VR Disc Golf 1.0 for the HTC Vive on Steam!

Please leave your feedback here on Steam and our developers will see it.  You can also email hello@frontrange.software to get in touch.

We are busy at work creating the next version with additional courses, multiplayer, league play, and more.

From everyone at Front Range Software, we would like to thank you for support in seeing VR Disc Golf launched today.

-- Front Range Software Development Team
